description: Provision a Google Cloud Iam IAMWorkforcePool via Config Connector. Fields mirror the iam.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 IAMWorkforcePool spec.

description.description: A user-specified description of the pool. Cannot exceed 256 characters.

disabled.description: Whether the pool is disabled. You cannot use a disabled pool to exchange tokens, or use existing tokens to access resources. If the pool is re-enabled, existing tokens grant access again.

displayName.description: A user-specified display name of the pool in Google Cloud Console. Cannot exceed 32 characters.

location.description: Immutable. The location for the resource

organizationRef.description: Immutable. The Organization that this resource belongs to. Only one of [organizationRef] may be specified. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The Google Cloud resource name of a Google Cloud Organization (format: `organizations/{{name}}`).

name.description:
[WARNING] Organization not yet supported in Config Connector, use 'external' field to reference existing resources.
Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

sessionDuration.description: How long the Google Cloud access tokens, console sign-in sessions, and gcloud sign-in sessions from this pool are valid. Must be greater than 15 minutes (900s) and less than 12 hours (43200s). If `session_duration` is not configured, minted credentials will have a default duration of one hour (3600s).

title: GCP Iam IAMWorkforcePool
